name: silicyte-amp-eval
clustering: transitive single linkage (union-find) on Levenshtein ratio

label_reliability.method: split-half over GRAMPA repeat measurements: split each sequence's measurements in two, take the median of each half, correlate across sequences, 200 random splits; Spearman-Brown corrected to full length
label_reliability.caveat: GRAMPA repeats are mostly different bacteria and strains, not replicate assays of one organism, so this is the reproducibility of median activity over a sample of organisms, which is what the label is. Do not quote it as a ceiling for single-organism potency.

baselines.protocol: pooled out-of-fold Spearman with tie correction; ridge predictions AVERAGED over a fixed penalty grid rather than selected, because at this sample size selecting the penalty on inner folds loses to averaging over it

what_this_corrects.defect: the clustering in common use compares each sequence only to cluster representatives and takes the first match, so it is not single linkage

measured_leak_on_the_uncorrected_split.note: the usual check passes perfectly because it tests a different quantity than the one the guard exists to bound
